review_scope: Separate maintainer-agent review of the post hoc arithmetic, source-bound replay, diagnostic evidence gating, narrative scope, privacy checks and additive CI commands. This is not independent human adjudication or replication of agent execution.

resolved_findings.finding: The early optional diagnostic scenario lacked exact executed helper/probe/command and closure bindings. Coherently changing the child program and matching start/end records passed the early support gate.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final code pins exact helper/probe source; parses CHILD as an inert AST literal; validates the full isolation command, source/arguments/case coverage, output, start/end and closure. Independently rehashed contradictory command records now reject.

resolved_findings.finding: An early arm validator used substring membership, permitting coherently changed empty/multiple-character arms.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final validator uses exact A/B/C membership; author negative controls cover changed schedule and outcome identities.

verification.privacy_scope: Local audit-directory scan and reviewed text only; not a new hosted CI result, full-history scan or guarantee against unknown sensitive strings.
verification.generated_outputs: The registered input map, report and full row ledger match an independent in-memory registration/calculation byte for byte. No output files were regenerated by this review.

limitations: Five families were chosen after published outcomes were known. The other 387 outcomes are carried forward, not semantically revalidated.
Nine trace-only fixed-width outcomes remain unresolved. The 72 supplemental candidate-case calls and one mechanism probe are new diagnostic evidence; this review only checks their retained records.

The descriptive interval includes zero and the observed difference is below the original 10-point threshold. No superiority, equivalence, efficiency, causal workflow benefit or independent replication is established.
Original policy decisions, status, grades and resource records stay unchanged; revised policy cross-tabs are post hoc.
This review ran no models, Docker, candidates or original verifier; process launch was denied during the independent calculation.
Final outer-manifest sealing, fresh-public-checkout replay, exact-head hosted CI and publication are separate integration steps.
